title: Professional Certificate Course in Principles and Frameworks for International Banking Supervisions and Compliances
description: Enhance your knowledge of international banking regulations and compliance frameworks with our Professional Certificate Course in Principles and Frameworks for International Banking Supervisions and Compliances.
longDescription: This course covers the essential principles for effective banking supervision, techniques of banking supervision, and the European institutional framework for prudential banking supervision. It also delves into the supervisory review process and its role in banking supervision and compliance. By the end of this course, students will have a comprehensive understanding of the principles and frameworks for international banking supervision and compliance.
